questions.question: When lifting a heavy bag of flour, what is the safest method?
options: Bend at the waist and lift quickly
Keep your back straight and lift with your legs
Hold the bag away from your body
questions.explanation: Lifting with your legs and keeping the load close reduces back injury risk.

questions.category: A2 — Apply safe food handling practices
questions.question: What is the correct minimum internal temperature for most baked goods containing eggs to be safely cooked?
options: Until the outside feels firm only
Until the product reaches a safe internal temperature
questions.explanation: Appearance alone is not always reliable; internal temperature confirms doneness and safety.

questions.category: A4 — Use and maintain baking tools and equipment
questions.question: Why should a scale be placed on a level surface before weighing ingredients?
options: To make it easier to clean
questions.explanation: An uneven scale can give inaccurate readings, affecting product quality.

questions.question: A baker needs bread ready for 8:00 a.m. What should be planned first?
options: The production schedule based on mixing, proofing, baking, and cooling times
questions.explanation: Production planning works backward from the required finish time.

questions.category: A6 — Manage bakery products and inventory
questions.question: What inventory method uses older stock before newer stock?
questions.explanation: FIFO helps prevent spoilage and waste.
